facts.text: Inspection scores range from 0 to 100. Higher is better.
Sushi restaurants have higher risk because of raw fish handling and parasite controls.
Critical violations can lead to immediate foodborne illness risk; noncritical ones are lower risk facility issues.
Blue Sushi (ins-001) latest score is 95 with grade A.
Taco Spot (ins-002) latest score is 88 with grade B.
Creating an inspection requires restaurant_name, cuisine, and score.
A closed placard means the facility was ordered closed after inspection findings.
Hot and cold holding temperature violations are common for restaurants that cook and store food in batches.
